story_text:
## Meet iMicro XL15
Designed for Curiosity
Whether you are a student discovering science, a creator exploring textures, an engineer inspecting details, or simply someone curious about the world around you, iMicro XL15 makes microscopic exploration more accessible than ever.
The microscopic world is not far away. It is already around us. All we need is a better way to see it.
Here are some example micrographs taken with iMicro XL15 (on iPhone 14 Pro):
## Our journey
Since 2018, we have been developing smartphone microscopes through our iMicro Fingertip Microscope series, including iMicro Q, iMicro C, iMicro Q2, iMicro Q2p, iMicro Q3, and iMicro Q3p.
With the support of our Kickstarter community, we have received more than 40,000 pledges and delivered over 70,000 iMicros to users in 75 countries.
After years of development and continuous refinement, we created the next generation of the Fingertip Microscope — iMicro XL15.
Unlike our high-magnification models, such as the iMicro Q3 and Q3p, the new iMicro XL15 is designed to make microscopic exploration easier, more enjoyable, and more creative.
With its large field of view, long working distance, stable focusing system, and newly designed removable lighting module, XL15 offers a new and more flexible way to explore the tiny details all around you.
It’s more than just a microscope lens.
It’s a complete micro exploration studio that fits in your pocket.
## Highlights
- Extended 21 mm Working Distance
- Wide 10 mm Field of View
- Newly designed dedicated Lighting Module
- Stable, Precise Focusing with the Improved FS-5 Stand
- Dedicated App and μRuler M included
- Easy attach with Nano-Suction Lens Mount
- Pocket-Ready Design, Complete Kit in one small Box
## Key features of iMicro XL15
## Super Long Working Distance, More Possibilities
Many microscopes have a very short working distance, making it difficult to observe three-dimensional objects or reach areas with limited access.
The iMicro XL15 lens features an extended 21 mm working distance, providing more space between the lens and the subject. This allows you to capture details that are difficult or impossible to observe with conventional smartphone microscopes, while also making positioning, focusing, and lighting adjustments much easier.
The following image shows an earbud charging case and a microscopic view of the charging contacts hidden deep inside a narrow hole — a detail that becomes accessible thanks to the long working distance of iMicro XL15.
## Super Large Field of View, See More at Once
The iMicro XL15 features an impressive 10 mm field of view, allowing you to observe a much larger area while still capturing fine details.
Instead of only seeing a small section of an object, XL15 helps you understand the complete structure and overall context.
As shown in the following image, the Apple Lightning charging connector can be viewed as a whole, while the fine details of the contacts remain clearly visible.
## Excellent Resolution, Down to 3 μm
The iMicro XL15 is not only designed for a large field of view and long working distance — it also delivers impressive optical resolution.
With a wide-angle camera, XL15 can resolve details down to 8 μm, while the telephoto camera mode can achieve resolution as fine as 3 μm, revealing intricate structures that are invisible to the naked eye.
This combination of wide-area observation and high-resolution imaging allows you to explore both the bigger picture and the finest details in the microscopic world.
## Ultra-Low Distortion, Desktop Microscope-Like Imaging
The iMicro XL15 is designed to deliver a remarkably flat and natural image across the entire field of view.
To evaluate optical distortion, we tested XL15 using a precision grid calibration target. The results showed no noticeable distortion, even at the edges of the image area.
This excellent optical performance helps preserve the true shape and proportions of observed objects, providing a clear and natural viewing experience comparable to a desktop microscope.
## A New Way to Illuminate the Microscopic World
Different lighting reveals different details.
Lighting plays a crucial role in microscopy. Previous iMicro models primarily relied on the smartphone's built-in flashlight, which offers convenience but limited control over illumination direction.
To give you more creative freedom, we developed a dedicated, removable Lighting Module for iMicro XL15.
The module fits neatly into the carrying case, which also serves as a sample stage. It provides convenient illumination for everyday observations. When you need more flexibility, simply remove the module and position it at different angles to reveal textures, enhance contrast, or create unique visual effects.
Explore with Different Lighting
- Direct Lighting — Natural colors and clear overall observation.
- Side Lighting — Highlights surface textures, contours, and fine details.
- Reflective Lighting — Creates distinctive effects when observing different materials.
- UV Illumination — Reveals fluorescence in suitable samples.
You can even combine the removable module with your smartphone's flashlight to experiment with multiple light sources.
One Sample. Different Lighting. Different Discoveries.
The images below show the same sugar crystals under different lighting colors and angles: white, tilted white, UV-blue, and red.
Notice how changing the illumination transforms their appearance, revealing different textures, structures, and colors.
With iMicro XL15, lighting becomes part of the exploration.
## Stable Focus Control with the Precision Focusing Stand
Based on valuable feedback from our dedicated backers, we redesigned and developed the FS-5 precision focusing stand and integrated it into the iMicro XL15.
Compared with the previous FS-3 stand, the FS-5 features a stronger and more robust structure, providing improved stability and more precise focus control during observation.
With a stable platform and smoother focusing experience, iMicro XL15 makes it easier to capture clear and consistent microscopic images.
## Ultra-Compact and Lightweight: Just 8.5 mm Thin and 1.2 g
Designed to be truly portable, the iMicro XL15 is about the size of a fingertip and weighs only 1.2 g (approximately 1/24 oz).
With an ultra-slim profile of just 8.5 mm (1/3 inch) in thickness, XL15 integrates seamlessly with your smartphone. When attached, no part of the lens extends beyond the edge of your phone, maintaining a clean and compact design.
Even with the dedicated focusing stand, the entire system remains compact and portable. After use, the focusing stand can be easily disassembled, and all components fit neatly back into the case, just as they were originally packed. The slim, card-like case slips easily into your pocket, keeping everything organized and ready for your next micro-exploration, anytime, anywhere.
Small enough to carry every day. Powerful enough to reveal a hidden world.
## μRuler and Dedicated App: Designed for Precise Measurement
For users who need accurate measurement, iMicro XL15 includes the μRuler M stage micrometer, a precision calibration tool designed to create an accurate scale bar within our dedicated i-SEEING app.
By calibrating the scale bar with μRuler M, you can measure the size of microscopic objects directly from your images — transforming your smartphone into a practical measurement tool.
iMicro XL15 works seamlessly with standard smartphone camera apps, allowing you to capture images with ease using built-in or external illumination.
For users who require calibrated measurements and more professional results, the dedicated i-SEEING app provides additional tools for microscopic imaging.
With i-SEEING, you can:
- Calibrate images with a precise scale bar
- Display or hide the scale bar when needed
- Capture and share microscope images with measurement information included
Whether you are exploring for curiosity, education, or professional applications, iMicro XL15 provides both simple smartphone imaging and advanced measurement capabilities when you need them.
Depth Enhancement — Coming to the i-SEEING App
By combining multiple photos captured at different focus positions, Depth Enhancement (Focus Stacking) aims to produce sharper images with a greater portion of the subject in focus.
We are currently developing this exciting new feature for the i-SEEING app. The demonstration below offers a preview of the enhanced image clarity and depth of focus we hope to achieve in a future update.
## Accessible Microscopy for Everyone
We believe that the beauty of microscopy should not be limited by cost.
Compared with traditional desktop microscopes, the iMicro XL15 offers a highly accessible way to explore the microscopic world at a fraction of the cost of a conventional desktop microscope.
This makes it an ideal tool for students, educators, makers, and anyone curious about the hidden details around us.
Instead of requiring expensive equipment and a dedicated workspace, iMicro XL15 brings microscopy into everyday life, making discovery more affordable, portable, and accessible for everyone.
## Works with Almost Any Smartphone
Like the previous iMicro Q series, the iMicro XL15 features a compact circular lens design that works with a wide range of smartphones.
Using a reusable nano-suction pad, the lens attaches securely and directly to your phone camera — no clips, adapters, or dedicated cases required.
Whether your smartphone has a single rear camera or a multi-camera system, with a flat or raised camera module, the compact round lens design makes alignment simple and convenient.
Just attach the lens, align it with your camera, and start exploring the microscopic world.
## How to use it
## Principle and development process
## Understanding Magnification
The magnification of a smartphone microscope is different from that of a traditional desktop microscope.
A conventional compound microscope mainly relies on optical magnification created by the combination of objective and eyepiece lenses. A smartphone microscope, however, combines optical magnification with the imaging capability of a smartphone.
In an iMicro fingertip microscope, magnification is achieved through three stages:
1. Optical Magnification
The microscope lens first magnifies the object and projects an enlarged image onto the smartphone camera sensor.
2. Electronic Magnification
The captured image is displayed on a much larger smartphone screen, allowing further visual enlargement.
3. Digital Magnification
Additional digital zoom can further enlarge the image for viewing and sharing.
The final displayed magnification is the result of these three stages working together — combining optical performance with the convenience and flexibility of modern smartphone imaging.
For iMicro XL15, our focus is not simply achieving the highest magnification, but creating a better overall exploration experience with a wide field of view, long working distance, and easy smartphone operation.

## Development Journey and Evolution
Our journey to create smartphone-based microscopic tools began in 2012, when we filed our first patent in this field.
Over the past decade, we have continuously explored, developed, and refined the concept of the fingertip microscope. This journey has resulted in a series of innovative products, including iMICROSCOPE, iMICROSCOPE R, μRuler, iMicro Q, iMicro C, iMicro Q2, iMicro Q2p, iMicro Q3, iMicro Q3p, and now the new-generation iMicro XL15.
With every generation, we have gained valuable experience from our users and backers. Their feedback and suggestions have guided us in improving not only optical performance, but also usability, portability, and the overall exploration experience.
From optical design and mechanical structure to user interaction and product packaging, every aspect has been carefully tested, refined, and optimized through multiple prototype iterations.

For iMicro XL15, we have carefully selected suppliers for key components, refined the manufacturing workflow, and implemented quality control procedures to ensure consistent product performance. While every new product involves challenges during production, our previous Kickstarter experience has helped us build the knowledge and capability needed to manage manufacturing, quality, and delivery effectively. Project Timeline We have created a detailed production plan with reasonable time buffers to account for potential challenges. However, unexpected issues may still arise during manufacturing, testing, or logistics. We are committed to addressing any challenges promptly and keeping our backers informed throughout the entire process. Regular updates will be provided to ensure transparency from development to delivery. Thank you for your trust and support as we bring iMicro XL15 from concept to reality.

faq.a:
A Fingertip Microscope is a compact microscope lens designed to work with your smartphone, transforming it into a portable microscope.

The name comes from its extremely small size — approximately the size of a fingertip. This compact design allows you to carry a microscope wherever you go and explore the microscopic world anytime.

Despite its tiny size, iMicro XL15 incorporates advanced optical design to deliver impressive imaging performance in a highly portable form factor.

faq.q: With such impressive optical performance, how can it be so affordable?
faq.a:
The affordability of iMicro XL15 comes from its innovative and simplified design.

Unlike traditional compound desktop microscopes, which require complex optical systems, mechanical structures, and dedicated equipment, iMicro XL15 uses a compact optical design combined with the imaging capability of your smartphone.

Optimized manufacturing processes and efficient mass production further help reduce production costs while maintaining reliable quality.

faq.q: How does the nano-suction pad attach to different surfaces?
faq.a:
The nano-suction pad works best on smooth, non-porous surfaces, such as smartphone camera covers and glass surfaces.

Its microscopic structure contains thousands of tiny contact areas that create adhesion through a suction-like effect.

However, performance may be reduced on rough, uneven, or textured surfaces because microscopic gaps can allow air to enter and reduce the adhesive effect.

faq.q: Which smartphones are compatible with iMicro XL15?
faq.a:
iMicro XL15 is designed for broad smartphone compatibility.

The compact circular lens design and nano-suction mounting system allow it to work with most smartphones and tablets equipped with a rear-facing camera, including devices with single or multiple camera systems.

No dedicated phone case or special adapter is required.

faq.q: How does the lens attach to the smartphone camera? Is it sticky?
faq.a:
iMicro XL15 attaches to your smartphone camera using a reusable nano-suction pad.

Unlike traditional adhesive materials, the nano-pad does not rely on glue. Its micro-structured surface creates thousands of tiny contact points that securely hold the lens in place while allowing easy removal and reuse.

For best performance, attach the lens to a clean, smooth, and non-porous surface.

faq.q: Does the nano-suction pad lose its adhesion over time?
faq.a:
With regular use, dust and particles may accumulate on the nano-suction surface and reduce adhesion.

Fortunately, it can be easily refreshed. Simply use a piece of stationery tape, such as 3M Scotch tape, to gently remove dust and restore its performance.

With proper care, the nano-suction pad can be reused many times.

faq.q: Can I use iMicro XL15 without the focusing stand?
faq.a:
Yes.

The lens can be used directly on your smartphone for quick and spontaneous observation.

For more stable observation and easier focusing, especially when capturing images or video, we recommend using the FS-5 focusing stand.

The stand provides a stable platform and allows more precise focus control.

faq.q: Why does iMicro XL15 have such a long working distance?
faq.a:
The 21 mm working distance provides considerably more space between the lens and your subject.

This makes it easier to observe three-dimensional objects, reach into narrow spaces, position samples, and adjust the lighting.

It also makes it possible to observe details that would be difficult to access with a microscope having a very short working distance.

faq.q: What can I see with iMicro XL15?
faq.a:
XL15 is designed for exploring a wide range of everyday subjects.

You can explore plants, insects, fabrics, paper, minerals, electronics, circuit boards, connectors, textures, coatings, and many other objects around you.

Its large field of view makes it particularly suitable for observing both fine details and the overall structure of an object.

faq.q: Why does iMicro XL15 use a movable lighting module?
faq.a:
Different lighting directions can reveal completely different details.

Direct light can show natural colors and overall structure, while low-angle side lighting can emphasize textures, edges, and surface relief. Reflective lighting can create special effects, while UV illumination can reveal fluorescence that is invisible under normal light.

The removable lighting module allows you to move the light source and change its position and angle according to your subject.

faq.q: Does the lighting module have its own battery?
faq.a:
Yes.

The removable lighting module has a built-in rechargeable battery, so it does not need to be connected to your phone or an external power bank while in use.

This keeps the setup compact and allows you to freely position the light around your subject.

The lighting module supports multiple lighting modes designed for different types of observation.

Depending on the selected mode, you can use direct white light, colored light, low-angle illumination, or UV illumination to reveal different features and visual effects.

faq.q: Can I use the UV light to see fluorescence?
faq.a:
Yes.

UV illumination can make certain fluorescent materials emit visible light, revealing colors and patterns that are difficult or impossible to see under normal illumination.

The effect depends on the material being observed. Many everyday objects can produce interesting fluorescence, while others may show little or no visible response.

UV illumination is intended as an exploration feature rather than a substitute for specialized fluorescence microscopy.

faq.q: What is the field of view of iMicro XL15?
faq.a:
The iMicro XL15 provides a field of view of approximately 10 mm, allowing you to observe a relatively large area at once.

This makes it easier to locate your subject and understand its overall structure, rather than seeing only a tiny portion of an object.

faq.q: What is the resolution of iMicro XL15?
faq.a:
Under our test conditions, iMicro XL15 can resolve details down to approximately 8 μm using a wide-angle camera and approximately 3 μm when using a telephoto camera.

Actual results may vary depending on the smartphone, camera, lighting, focusing, and imaging conditions.
